mails.body:
Dear Maria,

Please find attached the hours we processed for June 2026. For the next run we need any changes to contracted hours, new starters and leavers by Tue 14 Jul 2026. Hours above or below contract go to each person's hours account and are balanced with time off; overtime is paid out only when the home manager approves it.

If any of the figures look wrong, reply to this mail with the staff number and the corrected hours – please do not edit the file.

Kind regards
Tobias Schröder
Lohnbüro Sorantis
